tweets.text:
Happy 4th of July! Today, we celebrate the birth of our nation and the freedoms we cherish. As defense of America starts at our border, the men and women of the U.S. Coast Guard are applying our full range of capabilities to control, secure, and defend our maritime borders, ports, and waterways. 

As an Armed Service, and America's finest maritime fighting force, we are proud to stand alongside our fellow servicemembers and extend our gratitude to all who have dedicated their lives to defending our nation. Your service and sacrifice make our freedom possible.

@DHSgov @DeptofDefense
#4thofJuly #independenceday2025 #USCG #EveryWarEveryShore

tweets.text:
Today marks the beginning of a new chapter for @USCG. A nearly $25 billion investment will transform the Service through modernization of assets, infrastructure, and technology. This funding supports Force Design 2028, Secretary Noem’s comprehensive effort to modernize operations and capabilities to ensure the Coast Guard remains the finest maritime fighting force ready to protect and defend the American people for decades to come.  
 
We extend our deep appreciation for the leadership of the Administration, including @POTUS  and @Sec_Noem, and leaders in Congress for recognizing the strategic importance of a ready, modern, and resilient Coast Guard.

Always ready, the men and women of the Coast Guard remain on watch across our maritime borders and approaches, where defense of America begins.

#USCG #ForceDesign2028 #ValuetoNation #EveryWarEveryShore
@DHSgov

Press Release: https://t.co/P0ytCGeF62

tweets.text:
As flooding continues to impact Central Texas, the Coast Guard extends our deepest sympathies to the victims and their families.

Working closely with our federal and state partners, Coast Guard crews are conducting exhaustive search operations to locate those still missing.

As America’s maritime first responder, we remain relentless in our mission. We will continue to punch through.

tweets.text:
Amid the ongoing tragedy in Central Texas, the U.S. Coast Guard has deployed additional air assets to support the response.

As America’s maritime first responder, the Coast Guard is proud to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with our interagency partners.

Our service members remain always ready, vigilant, and steadfast in our commitment to the people of Central Texas.

#USCG #AmericasFirstResponder #ValuetoNation
@Sec_Noem @DHSgov
